newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon to create industry ministry.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon to create industry ministry.

text.p: The Lebanese cabinet approved a draft law for setting up a separate ministry to stimulate industrial development and secure new markets.
The industry portfolio is currently part of the Industry and Oil Ministry. Under the new law, which requires parliamentary approval, the two portfolios will have separate ministries.
The Industry Ministry will have the following aims according to a statement issued by the cabinet after a Wednesday night session:
- Organise, protect and coordinate industrial activities,
- Grant licences for creating new industries,
- Help the creation of industrial towns and zones,
- Sponsor import substitution and secure new markets for Lebanese industrial products,
- Modernise legislation linked to industry and to international conventions concerning the sector,
- Organise industrial fairs and participate in international exhibitions,
- Prepare an action plan to improve the technical level of the workforce and channel the skills needed to develop industry, and
- Carry out studies and statistical surveys and collect information on industrial investment.
